synth.final_message:
`python3 check.py` prints **ALL PASS** (19/19 transitions).

These are the rules in `program.py`:

| Action | Effect |
|---|---|
| 3 | The cursor moves to the previous editable glyph column. From the first column, it goes to the last. |
| 4 | The cursor moves to the next editable glyph column. From the last column, it goes to the first. |
| 1, 2 | No visible change. The objects have no `pixels` field, so a change to a glyph cannot be seen. |
| Others | No change. |

The program gets the columns from the `x` values of the `glyph` objects. Thus it also works for other layouts.

These points are not confirmed, because the transitions do not show them:
- Actions 5, 6 and 7.
- A win check when the editable words match the reference words.

The header comment of `program.py` records the same points.
